title: Rommel’s Treasure
overview: Corsica, one of the most majestic islands on Earth, has gained fame not only for its beauty, but also for the stories and legends that surround it, and especially one: Rommel’s treasure. This documentary will look for Rommel’s famous treasure, in search of which many adventurers have traveled to Corsica, while giving viewers the opportunity to learn about its history, its culture and its enchanting mysterious landscapes. Will we find out the truth about Rommel’s hidden treasure?
